title: Rebrand to Star Field Explorer and update messaging

requirements.summary: Update application title from 'Star Fields' to 'Star Field Explorer' in the HTML entry point
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title displays 'Star Field Explorer'
The HTML title tag contains 'Star Field Explorer'

file_operations.description: Change the <title> tag content from 'Star Fields' to 'Star Field Explorer' to update the browser tab title

requirements.summary: Update Header component branding from 'Star Fields' to 'Star Field Explorer'
acceptanceCriteria: The header displays 'Star Field Explorer' as the brand name
The Moon icon remains visible next to the brand name

file_operations.description: Update the branding text from 'Star Fields' to 'Star Field Explorer' while preserving the Moon icon and existing header structure

requirements.summary: Replace main page header text with new messaging about tracking the Moon and understanding Nakshatras
acceptanceCriteria: The main heading displays 'Track the Moon. Understand the Moment.'
The description text about Nakshatras is displayed below the heading
The text maintains appropriate typography hierarchy and spacing

file_operations.description: Replace the existing header text with 'Track the Moon. Understand the Moment.' as the main heading (h1), followed by a description paragraph explaining Nakshatras: 'A Nakshatra is one of 27 lunar mansions — sacred segments of the sky the Moon travels through each month in Vedic astrology. Each Nakshatra carries a distinct emotional, psychological, and karmic tone. As the Moon moves, the feeling of time shifts. This app helps you recognize that rhythm — not to predict fate, but to understand the energy shaping the present moment.' Maintain appropriate spacing and typography hierarchy

file_operations.description: Remove the expandable pada details section including the expand/collapse functionality, navamsa sign, title, degree range, and interpretive description. Keep the banner structure showing the current Nakshatra name and Moon icon with essential information
